summary: Head-and-shoulders top (头肩顶), the mirror image of the head-and-shoulders bottom, used as a short-entry signal. Short on the neckline break, stop 5%-7% (a close back above the neckline), and measure the target as the neckline-break level minus the vertical distance from the head to the neckline; a second wave subtracts the same distance again. Three cases: 日月光 daily 1997 (sloped neckline), 中釉 weekly 2011 (flat neckline) and the 营建类 sector index weekly 1995-1999 (a compound top with two head highs, whose midpoint is used; it also shows an upside measured move from the earlier bottom and the post-break 'escape line' rebound).

patterns.structure: Left shoulder, a higher head, and a lower right shoulder over a common neckline through the two troughs. The neckline may be flat (schematic 70, 中釉 20.7) or sloped (日月光: rising, 15 under the head and 16.4 at the break).
patterns.entry: Short when price breaks the neckline (破线), e.g. schematic short ~69 below the 70 neckline; 日月光 short ~16 on the 1997-10-17 heavy-volume black candle (带量翻黑) through 16.4; 中釉 ~20.5 the week it broke 20.7; 营建类 ~420 after the break at ~429.
patterns.stop: 5%-7%, i.e. a close back above the neckline (站回颈线之上). Examples: 日月光 16.8 (~5%); 中釉 21.7, the high where the fall started 2 weeks earlier (~6%); 营建类 440 (~5%).

target.formula: distance = head high (or the midpoint of two head highs) - neckline directly below it; target_1 = neckline-break level - distance; target_2 = target_1 - distance.

confirmation: A heavy-volume black candle breaking the neckline (日月光 带量翻黑破线).
Falling volume through the head and right shoulder (the 日月光 chart draws a descending volume trendline).
The pullback can't get back above the neckline (反压站不回).
A rebound after the break that fails below the neckline (escape line / rising flag as a bear continuation).
invalidation: A close back above the neckline after the break (the stop).

patterns.name_zh: 复合式头肩顶（合式头肩顶）
patterns.structure: A head-and-shoulders top whose head is a double top (two near-equal highs, 营建类 595.21 / 594.05), formed over more than two years.
patterns.entry: Short on the weekly neckline break (1998-08-01 week; short ~420).
patterns.stop: ~440, a reclaim of the neckline (~5% risk).

target.formula: distance = midpoint of the two head highs - neckline; target = neckline-break level - distance

confirmation: The post-break rebound forms a rising flag (上飘旗形, bear continuation) that stays under the neckline (escape line).
invalidation: Weekly close back above the neckline (~440 stop).

patterns.name_zh: 底部突破 → 涨幅满足（等幅计算）
patterns.name_en: Bottom breakout with an equal-distance upside target
patterns.structure: 营建类 weekly: a roughly one-year bottom with a flat neckline; a breakout (1996-04-06 week), a first wave to 396.83, a pullback to 352.8, then a break above the prior high.
patterns.entry: Go long on the neckline breakout (多单进场).
patterns.stop: A break back below the neckline (跌破颈线停损).

target.formula: target = pullback low + (first-wave high - bottom low), computed once the prior high is cleared

confirmation: Clearing the prior high after the pullback triggers the calculation.

rules.rule: The head-and-shoulders top is the mirror image of the head-and-shoulders bottom, just as the M top mirrors the W bottom.
rules.quote_zh: 如同W底与M头的反向关系，头肩顶是头肩底的反向关系。

rules.rule: First target = neckline - (head high - neckline); second target = first target - the same distance.
rules.quote_zh: 头部高点90至颈线位置70（颈线假设为平行线）距离20。跌破平行的颈线位置70-20=等幅计算的跌幅满足50。若需再计算第二波跌幅满足，第一波跌幅满足点50-20=等幅计算的跌幅满足30。

rules.rule: Short on the neckline break, stop within 5%-7% (a close back above the neckline); if the pullback can't reclaim it, take profit near the one- or two-wave target (27%-56% in the schematic).
rules.quote_zh: 跌破颈线时，空单进场，如空在69附近，停损设5%～7%以内，也是站回颈线之上时，反压站不回，看一至两波的跌幅满足附近，空单获利了结，约27%～56%。

rules.rule: The target can be computed on the day the neckline breaks; with a sloped neckline, measure vertically from the head to the neckline and subtract from the break level.
rules.quote_zh: 破线当日，便可计算跌幅满足。❶自头部高点20.3元垂直至颈线位置约在15元附近，距离约5.3元。❷跌破颈线位置约在16.4元附近-5.3元=等幅计算的跌幅满足11.1元。

rules.rule: A heavy-volume black candle through the neckline confirms the head-and-shoulders top.
rules.quote_zh: 日月光日线1997年10月17日带量翻黑，跌破颈线头肩顶确立

rules.rule: The stop is a close back above the neckline, which acts as resistance (~5%).
rules.quote_zh: 停损设16.8元，也就是站上颈线反压风险约5%，反压站不回，看跌幅满足附近，空单回补获利约30%。

rules.rule: Alternative stop: the high from which the fall started a few bars before the break (中釉: the high 2 weeks earlier, 21.7, ~6%).
rules.quote_zh: 约可空在20.5元附近，停损设在2周前起跌高点21.7元，风险约6%

rules.rule: With two head highs (compound top), measure from their midpoint to the neckline.
rules.quote_zh: （头部有两个高点双头，称为复合式头肩顶。）❶自头部两个高点的中间值约595点至颈线位置约390点，距离205点。

rules.rule: Upside measured move after a bottom: once the prior high is cleared after a pullback, target = pullback low + (first-wave high - bottom low).
rules.quote_zh: 大涨一波拉回整理后再过前高时，便可计算涨幅满足。

rules.rule: When the top is much larger than the earlier bottom, price easily breaks below the bottom's low.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面结构上头部的规模远大于底部的规模，因此容易跌破底部低点。

rules.rule: The rebound after a completed top is a rising flag (bear continuation); a rebound that fails to clear the neckline is the 'escape line' (逃命线).
rules.quote_zh: 跌破颈线头部完成后的反弹形成上飘旗形（空头中继站），反弹未过颈线，便是技术面所谓的逃命线。

worked_examples.outcome: Broke 1997-10-17 on a heavy-volume black candle; target reached 1997-10-30 (low 10.9), then a V reversal; short profit ≈30%
Broke the neckline in the 2011-06-18 week; reached the target near year-end 2011 (low 10.37); short profit ≈48%

worked_examples.pattern: 约一年底部 → 涨幅满足 → 逾二年复合式头肩顶 → 跌幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: Bottom breakout 1996-04-06; target zone reached 1997-03; neckline broken in the 1998-08-01 week; rising-flag rebound below the neckline; target reached around 1999-02; short profit ≈46%

quantifiable: Head-and-shoulders top detector: three swing highs with the middle one highest; the neckline is a line through the two intervening swing lows (flat or sloped); signal = close below the neckline value at that bar.
Target: d = head_high - neckline_value_at_head_bar (vertical); target_1 = neckline_value_at_break - d; target_2 = target_1 - d.
Compound head: if two head highs are within ~1% of each other, use their mean as head_high.
Stop: close back above the neckline, capped at 5%-7% from entry; alternatively the swing high a few bars before the break.
Volume confirmation (optional): the break bar is bearish with volume above average; volume declines from the left shoulder/head to the right shoulder.
Post-break rebound to the neckline that fails (逃命线 / 上飘旗形) = an add-on or late-entry short with a stop above the neckline.
Upside version: after a bottom breakout, once close > first-wave high H1: target = pullback low L2 + (H1 - bottom low L1).
ambiguities: Which level the distance is subtracted from varies: the schematic and 中釉 use the flat neckline; 日月光 uses the sloped neckline's level at the break (16.4) and a vertical distance to its level under the head (15); 营建类 uses the break level 429 while measuring to a neckline of 390 (the neckline rises from ~390 under the head to ~429 at the break).
Entries are 'about' a level (69, 16, 20.5, 420), slightly below the neckline; the exact fill rule (close vs. intrabar) isn't specified.
Stop rules differ: a neckline reclaim (日月光, 营建类), the high 2 weeks earlier (中釉), or a blanket 5%-7% (schematic).
When to take the second wave instead of the first isn't specified in this unit (the schematic says 'one to two waves').
营建类 overshot its target (224) to 185.44; the book still calls it 'reaching the target'.
p79 heads the pattern 合式头肩顶 while p80 calls it 复合式头肩顶; same pattern.
